summary: Render deterministic workflow conflict statuses, source files and classification origin inline with project-question results.
decision_refs: The active goal requires continued RFI, Submittal and Email accuracy and adaptability
The user requires evidence to appear with the corresponding result rather than in a separate tab
A synthetic fixture proved that the full-run conflict preflight named neither the actual statuses nor their source files
approval_evidence: The user's persistent objective and earlier inline-evidence requirement authorize this accuracy and usability correction.
known_limitations: Workflow-index provenance identifies the original file and explicit indexed status but is not an exact quotation or page locator.
The feature requires an exact RFI or Submittal identifier and a status-oriented question; generic Email-thread status remains retrieval-bounded.
The answer prose lists at most three files per status, while the structured inline source list retains every file.
The guard preserves ambiguity and does not determine chronology, revision precedence, authority or contractual correctness.
